explanation: Use Fisher–Yates to choose each next position uniformly from the remaining positions, starting with 0 through n−1. A persistent random engine avoids reseeding every call. The wrapper retains one million statistical trials and additionally verifies permutation membership.
timeComplexity: O(n) algorithm time per sample; the unchanged trial count also includes rank/structure checks.
spaceComplexity: O(n) result space and O(1) further algorithm space; the wrapper retains statistical sample ranks.
attribution: Original C++ implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract and repository-authored C# algorithms. Uses the existing local native test-framework API. No upstream reference implementation was altered or translated.
